text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even just the announcement of<n>Symboli Rudolf's
debut race has<n>caused quite a stir in the racing
world,<n>but she herself seems unfazed by the
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She has told me her objectives: first<n>to claim the
Classic Triple Crown,<n>then to cement her status as
the true<n>Emperor with further accolades.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Together, we set out to realize her<n>vision: a world
in which all<n>Umamusume can live in bliss!
